reviewer: independent read-only visual design review (agent), round 2, 2026-10-13, at commit d042734 (3.0.2 build)
summary: The 3.0.2 build looks good: the deep navy and cyan P3R language (slanted buttons, chamfered cards, calendar-plate dates, condensed italic numerals) is applied consistently across app screens, sheets and widgets in both palettes. Hierarchy on Today, Schedule and the result sheets is clear, and the 130%/115% large-font layouts reflow without clipping. 16 of the 18 previous issues are fully fixed; the watermark is partly fixed and the README 社群 shot was still mid-scroll. Remaining items are minor (some widget title lines ending on 「·」, one legacy location starting with 「／」, widget note lines cut with an ellipsis, locked-day widgets with two disabled buttons) plus README polish. No blockers, no major defects, no missing-glyph boxes or broken 「→」.

dangling 「/」 in 参考回答 at 130%; arrow/dash spacing; RANK/MAX font style in two body texts; episode chip spacing; stepper heights; bullet style; 剧情自动推进 tag at 130%
